metric.name: Share of Northern prawn in sample below minimum length

legal_relevance.statement: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/2201 permits control authorities to recommend a real-time closure from one sample when juvenile Northern prawn exceed 40%, and the coastal Member State may close an area on the basis of sampling reports.

forbidden_inferences: The 66.50% value is itself the legal closure polygon.
The sample necessarily and solely caused HVMFS 2025:4 unless a source explicitly binds it to that decision.
The metric observation owns the duration of any closure.
notes: Direct official metric. Its relation to the specific HVMFS 2025:4 closure is retained as DERIVED in the spatial state, not promoted to direct causation.
